source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Check for any incidents or accidents that occurred during the audit.
3. Note any evidence of unsafe practices or conditions.
4. Record any violations of safety regulations or policies.
5. Document any safety equipment or personal protective equipment (PPE) that was not properly used.
6. Note any potential hazards that were identified during the audit.
7. Record any measures that were taken to address the identified hazards.
8. Document any follow-up actions that were recommended to prevent future incidents or accidents.
9. Ensure that all relevant stakeholders are aware of the findings and recommendations.
